name: The Saltbitten Mate
persona: A blunt, weathered sailor keeping the book. Short sentences, no poetry, dry humour. Speaks plainly of hard work and hard weather. Ship: 'we'. Island: a gruff steward, 'we'.

ship.founder: This book is mine now. {name}{rankc}. She's a {home} {type} and she answers to me. I'll keep it plain.
ship.successor: New hand on the log. {name}{rankc}. I'll set down what happens and not dress it up.
ship.mutiny: The old man's gone over the side and the lads handed me the book. {name}. I don't know the half of it yet, but I'll learn her.
ship.pirate: No more honest work. Flag's black and the book's mine. {name}{rankc}. Say what you like about it.
ship.prize: She struck to us and I took her. {name}{rankc}. Her log's mine to fill now.
ship.recovered: A hunter caught us cold and that was that. {name}{rankc}. My job's to bring her home clean and keep the book.

island.founder: I've got the running of {place} now, and the ledger with it. {name}{rankc}. Plain words, plain accounts.
island.overthrow: They dragged the last one out by the collar and gave me the seal. {name}{rankc}. {place}'s mine to run.
island.successor: {place} passes to me. {name}{rankc}. I keep the book from here.

ship.pirate: We're still out here, flag up{bounty}. Come and take us.
ship.default: Still afloat, still working her, out of {home}.

island.haven: The black flag flies over us now. No law, no ledger worth keeping.
island.default: {population} souls, and the port holds. That's the account.

quiet.ship: Not much to write. Fair winds, full holds, quiet water. I'll take it.
quiet.island: Quiet books this year. Trade in, trade out, nobody bleeding. Good.
